worldcombat.skill.tarshot.summary: Hurls a glob of sticky tar at one target: on a hit it coats them, lowering their Speed stage and gumming up their movement, and while coated their weakness to Fire is doubled - any Fire-type move deals about x2 damage. The impact leaves a patch of tar on the ground that coats non-allies who step in, and water washes the tar off.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.use.0: Coat a target ahead of an ally's Fire move
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.use.1: Slow a fast target and push it back
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.use.2: Turn a patch of ground into a tar pit that sticks to anyone
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.description.0: A coated target loses %1$s Speed stage(s) and carries the tar for about %2$s; getting wet or rain washes it off.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.description.1: While coated, its weakness to Fire is doubled: any Fire-type move deals about x%1$s damage.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.description.2: The tar flies at about %1$s blocks per tick, with a %2$s block hit radius and up to %3$s blocks of range; a wide splash covers about %4$s blocks and flings about %5$s droplets.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.description.3: The impact leaves a tar patch of about %1$s blocks for about %2$s; non-allies stepping in are coated too.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.option.on: Wide splash: non-allies around the impact are coated too and the patch is bigger, at reach -2 blocks, flight about x0.85, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +10 ticks - coating a whole group, but slower, shorter and costlier.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.option.off: Focused: only the target hit is coated (a small patch still forms at the impact), with longer reach, faster flight and a shorter wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, spends %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.growth.0: At level %1$s the coat lasts %2$s and the tar patch lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.tarshot.preference.wid: On: non-allies around the impact are coated too and the tar patch is bigger, at reach -2 blocks, flight about x0.85, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +10 ticks - coating a whole group, but slower, shorter and costlier. Off (focused): only the target hit is coated (a small patch still forms at the impact), with longer reach, faster flight and a shorter wind-up and cooldown.
The companion only considers tar on a threat within this distance; lower keeps it close, higher lets it open from farther.
On: a target already carrying tar is not coated again - the value is opening the Fire weakness, and a second coat adds nothing; off: coat again to refresh the duration.
When on, the companion may leave its post to throw tar even under a hold order.
